property_summary: For any admissible deposit amount, a call to withdrawAll from any address with zero credit must succeed without reverting; the mutant attempts a zero-value external call to the caller, which reverts for a counterparty that cannot receive ETH.
change_summary: Change the guard `if (oCredit > 0)` to `if (oCredit >= 0)` so withdrawals are attempted even when credit is zero, triggering a value-transfer call and revert path that the original never executes.
